    SELECT
        order_id,

    GROUP BY order_id

    SELECT

        SUM(shipping_fee) AS total_shipping
    FROM order_shipments

tasks.name: Clickstream Sessionization with Inactivity Gaps
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) IS NULL THEN 1
            WHEN event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS new_session_flag
    FROM user_events
),
sessions AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id
            ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) AS session_id
    FROM ordered
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM sessions
GROUP BY
    user_id,
    session_id
ORDER BY
    user_id ASC,
    session_start ASC;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH lagged AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE 
                 OR LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_new_session
    FROM user_events
),
session_indexed AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CAST(SUM(is_new_session) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS BIGINT) AS session_id
    FROM lagged
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM session_indexed
GROUP BY user_id, session_id
ORDER BY user_id ASC, session_start ASC;

    FROM user_journey_events
    WHERE event_name = 'view_item'
    GROUP BY user_id
),
first_cart AS (
    SELECT
        fv.user_id,
        MIN(e.event_time) AS cart_time
    FROM first_view fv
    JOIN user_journey_events e
        ON e.user_id = fv.user_id
        AND e.event_name = 'add_to_cart'
        AND e.event_time > fv.view_time
    GROUP BY fv.user_id
),
first_purchase AS (
    SELECT
        fc.user_id,
        MIN(e.event_time) AS purchase_time
    FROM first_cart fc
    JOIN user_journey_events e
        ON e.user_id = fc.user_id
        AND e.event_name = 'purchase'
        AND e.event_time > fc.cart_time
    GROUP BY fc.user_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM first_view)           AS total_viewers,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM first_cart)           AS converted_cart,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM first_purchase)      AS converted_purchase;

WITH user_stages AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'view_item' THEN event_time END) AS view_time,

        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'purchase' THEN event_time END) AS purchase_time
    FROM user_journey_events
    GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN view_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS total_viewers,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN view_time IS NOT NULL AND cart_time > view_time THEN 1 END) AS converted_cart,
